card.name: Closing quote after exclamation or question
card.fires_on: The closing quotation mark right after a ! or ? that ends a line of quoted speech in stories, quotes and articles. It fires where the quote ends and a speaker tag or new sentence may follow.

modes.label: Exclamation closes quote
modes.description: The mark after an exclamation point ends quoted speech, often followed by a speaker tag.
modes.example: “I loved everything<<!”>> exclaimed one student on his evaluation.

modes.label: Question closes quote
modes.description: The mark after a question mark ends a quoted question, followed by who said it.
modes.example: "Where did you get that<<?">> said the Hahái Wuhti.

card.plain: It notices the point where a quoted shout or question ends, just before the text says who spoke or moves on.
